A dash means fewer than 5 postings mention the theme, or the track has fewer than 20 postings; such cells are not published.

## Method

79 public full-text job postings for senior product, engineering and programme roles, first seen 2026-09-15 – 2026-09-19 on employer career boards and job boards during one job search, deduplicated by employer and title. The track comes from the job title, with content checks to exclude functions outside scope; design, marketing, sales and similar functions are excluded. Claude Sonnet 5 classified the first 60 postings and GPT Astra completed the remaining batch against the criteria below, retaining evidence for every marked theme. GPT Astra checked a deterministic random sample of eight retained postings and the flagged ambiguous cases against the full source text. Author and review records are retained privately. A posting counts once per theme. “The role itself involves AI” means the role owns AI or machine-learning products, features, models, teams or infrastructure; using AI tools does not count. The sample leans towards international fintech and business software and is not a market survey. This edition has too few engineering postings to publish that track.

### What counts for each theme

- **LLM fundamentals:** experience with or knowledge of LLMs, generative AI or foundation models
- **Inference, serving and cost:** AI/ML serving, inference or GPU infrastructure, or the latency and cost of AI workloads
- **RAG and retrieval:** retrieval-augmented generation, semantic or vector search, embeddings
- **Agents, tools and protocols:** AI agents, agentic workflows, AI tool use or agent protocols such as MCP
- **Fine-tuning and post-training:** training or fine-tuning machine-learning models
- **Evaluation and observability:** evaluating, testing or monitoring the quality of AI/ML systems
- **Safety, security and governance:** responsible AI, AI risk, AI regulation or the security of AI systems; general security or financial compliance without AI does not count
- **Multimodal and voice:** speech, vision or multimodal AI
- **AI system design:** designing the architecture of AI/ML systems or platforms; general software architecture does not count
- **Practical coding:** hands-on coding in the role or proficiency in a named programming language
- **AI product strategy and metrics:** product strategy, roadmap, metrics or the business case for AI/ML products or features; general product strategy does not count
- **AI platform and operating model:** internal AI platforms, AI adoption or transformation across an organisation, AI enablement
- **Leading engineering teams:** managing engineers or engineering managers: hiring, coaching, performance, team or organisation design
- **Programmes and delivery:** leading cross-functional delivery: roadmaps, planning, dependencies, launches and execution across teams
- **Applied and customer scenarios:** customer-facing technical deployment: forward-deployed, solutions or pilot work with customers
- **Payments and regulated domains:** payments, banking, lending, insurance, fintech or financial-regulation domain experience
